info.name: [preview] Get a List of Form Templates.

params.name: ids
params.description: A comma-separated list containing up to 100 template IDs to filter on.

params.name: after
params.description: If specified, this should be the endCursor value from the previous page of results. When present, this request will return the next page of results that occur immediately after the previous page of results.

items.docs: Returns a list of the organization's form templates. Rate limit: 5 requests/sec (learn more about rate limits here).
